lines.en: label wakanaspring7:
scene nightsky
It’s another night in Kumon-mi, which means-
lines.zh: 又是一个 Kumon-mi 的夜晚，也就是说——

lines.en: Oh, good. Another perfectly timed phone call to distract me from whatever sad stuff is going on inside of my head and force me back into a state of conformational normalcy.
lines.zh: 哦，好极了。又一个时机掐得刚刚好的电话，正好把我从脑子里那些破事里拽出来，逼我重新装回一副正常人的样子。

lines.en: Good. I didn’t feel like narrating today anyway.
lines.zh: 很好。反正我今天也不想旁白。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hello.
: Oh, Wakana. Is it time for our regularly scheduled unpaid therapy session again?
lines.zh: : 哦，Wakana。又到了我们定期举行的、没有报酬的心理治疗时间了？

lines.en: : Better. It’s time to get drunk.
lines.zh: : 比那更好。该去喝醉了。

lines.en: : Sure. But let me warn you that if this is some sort of secret operation to make me so drunk that I confess to the many sins I’ve been hiding from you, it isn’t going to work. I know from experience.
lines.zh: : 行啊。不过先提醒你，如果这是什么秘密行动，打算把我灌醉好让我招出那些一直瞒着你的罪，那是没用的。我有经验。

lines.en: : Yes, I’ve heard the stories. And no, that is not what is happening.
lines.zh: : 是的，那些故事我听说过。不是，这次不是那么回事。

lines.en: : I will still likely complain about things to you, though. I like the catharsis that comes from getting my frustrations out onto something that doesn’t involve proofreading.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概还是会跟你抱怨。我喜欢把憋着的东西倒出来那种宣泄感，只要不用拿去校对就行。

lines.en: : Yeah. Sadness starts feeling a lot less sad once you have to read over it and start correcting the spelling of stuff.
lines.zh: : 是啊。一旦你得把它重读一遍、还得订正拼写，悲伤就没那么悲伤了。

lines.en: : Correct. But before you start heading to our regular bar, I’d like to warn you that I’m at the other one right now.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过在你动身去我们常去的那家之前，我得提醒你，我现在在另外一家。

lines.en: : The one I shan’t ever speak the name of out loud? That houses one of my greatest admirers and sometimes the covert agent of Satan that she created via human reproduction?
lines.zh: : 那个我死也不会把名字念出声的地方？那个住着我最狂热的仰慕者之一、偶尔还住着她通过人类繁殖造出来的那个撒旦秘密特工的地方？

lines.en: : Do not speak to me of human reproduction right now. I’m not in the mood.
lines.zh: : 现在别跟我提人类繁殖。我没那个心情。

lines.en: : Oh no. Don’t tell me you’ve transitioned to full-on homosexuality. We haven’t even kissed yet.
lines.zh: : 哦不。别告诉我你已经转成了彻底的同性恋。我们连吻都还没接过呢。

lines.en: : Sakaki-bar-a. Now.
lines.zh: : Sakaki-bar-a。现在就过来。

lines.en: Wakana hangs up the phone and I quickly start making my way over to [[REDACTED].
lines.zh: Wakana 挂了电话，我赶紧动身往那个 [[REDACTED]] 去。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes1
I also hold steady to that thing I said earlier about not wanting to narrate. Surprise. I’m here.
lines.zh: 我说过今天不想旁白，这点我坚持。惊喜吧。我到了。

lines.en: : Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 荒川。

lines.en: : Watabe.
lines.zh: : 渡部。

lines.en: : Sakakibara.
lines.zh: : 榊原。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes2
: Sorry. It didn’t seem like anyone else was going to say my name and I felt left out.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。看样子没人打算念我的名字，我觉得被冷落了。

lines.en: : I’ll take this box of clothes and go away now.
lines.zh: : 我把这箱衣服放下，这就走。

lines.en: : Going through a goth phase, Sara?
lines.zh: : 走哥特风了，Sara？

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes3
: Me? No way. I tried that once in high school and there is just no way I have the time to maintain that aesthetic as an adult. These are for Sana.
lines.zh: : 我？不可能。高中时试过一次，成年后哪还有时间维持那种造型。这些是给 Sana 的。

lines.en: : I just fear it might be a little too late as she isn’t as reserved as she was when we first talked about this exchange several years ago.
lines.zh: : 我只是怕有点太迟了——她已经不像几年前我们头一回聊这场交换时那么内向了。

lines.en: : Apologies for taking so long to bring you that box. I’ve just been so preoccupied by the time it takes to maintain this aesthetic as an adult.
lines.zh: : 这么久才把箱子给你送来，抱歉。成年后维持这套造型要花的时间，把我占得死死的。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes4
: I’ll make sure she gets them. But don’t feel offended if you don’t see her wearing them any time soon. I can no longer control that girl and often feel as if she is the one controlling me now.
lines.zh: : 我会确保她拿到的。不过要是你短期内看不到她穿，别觉得被冒犯。我管不住那丫头了，反而常常觉得现在是她在管我。

lines.en: : Noted. I am perfectly content with never seeing your daughter again. So perhaps we just won’t cross paths at all and I will be none the wiser.
lines.zh: : 明白了。我完全乐意这辈子再也不见你女儿。所以也许我们干脆别再碰面，我也乐得不知情。

lines.en: : Now, that’s just rude.
lines.zh: : 这就有点失礼了吧。

lines.en: : Be gone, barmaid. You have overstayed your welcome and our transaction is over.
lines.zh: : 退下吧，酒保。你待得太久了，我们这笔交易已经结束。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re not looking for another job, are you? Because I could use another cool and mysterious woman now that my last one broke down.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你不是在找新工作吧？我这儿正缺一个又酷又神秘的女人，上一个已经坏掉了。

lines.en: : No. But if I ever give up on my career and dedicate the rest of my life to spiting my parents, I’ll be sure to let you know.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过要是哪天我放弃事业、把余生都用来气我父母，我一定通知你。

lines.en: : I’ll take it. A win is a win in this economy. Need another drink? They’re on me tonight as thanks for the box of misery.
lines.zh: : 行，算一个。这年头赢一次是一次。还要再来一杯吗？今晚我请，就当谢你那箱惨兮兮的衣服。

lines.en: : Ten. And ten for my partner here as well.
lines.zh: : 十杯。这位同伴也来十杯。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes5
: Partner?
lines.zh: : 同伴？

lines.en: : Partner.
lines.zh: : 同伴。

lines.en: : Sakakibara.
lines.zh: : 榊原。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes6
: I’ll see myself out now.
lines.zh: : 那我自己走了。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes7
: So, you seem to have gotten a decently-sized head start. Maybe now I can finally manage to outlast you in the inebriation department.
lines.zh: : 看来你已经领先不少了。也许今天我终于能在酒量这科上撑过你了。

lines.en: : You likely will. My medication doesn’t react well with alcohol.
lines.zh: : 你大概会。我的药跟酒精犯冲。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes8
: I’d say you should probably stop drinking then. But I’m also not sure if it’s the same one you were taking when we had that foursome, and I don’t want to ruin my chances at a second one.
lines.zh: : 那我该说你最好别喝了。可我也不确定这是不是我们那次四人行时你吃的那款，我可不想毁掉第二次的机会。

lines.en: : It’s a different one.
lines.zh: : 是另一种。

lines.en: : You should probably stop drinking then.
lines.zh: : 那你大概还是别喝了。

lines.en: : This medication just winds up turning me on and then making me tired.
lines.zh: : 这药就是先把我搞兴奋，再让我犯困。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes9
: Where is your bag? I’ll go get you some more.
lines.zh: : 你的包呢？我去给你再拿点。

lines.en: : Heh. You would.
lines.zh: : 呵。你倒是会。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes10
: Of course I would. You-
lines.zh: : 我当然会。你——

lines.en: : You are smiling.
lines.zh: : 你在笑。

lines.en: : I smile sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我有时候会笑。

lines.en: : But never after I make passes at you, so something must be seriously wrong.
lines.zh: : 但我挑逗你之后你从来不笑，所以肯定是出了什么大事。

lines.en: : Care to take a guess?
lines.zh: : 猜猜看？

lines.en: : You have converted to full-on homosexuality. But it wasn’t until then that you realized your feelings for me and now it’s too late to go back.
lines.zh: : 你已经转成了彻底的同性恋。可直到那一刻你才察觉对我的感情，现在想回头已经太迟了。

lines.en: : Arakawa, may I ask exactly what you see in me?
lines.zh: : 荒川，我能问问你到底看上我什么了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes11
: Uhh...why?
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么？

lines.en: : Curiosity, I suppose. You just make “passes” so often that there must be something about those feelings worth noting apart from me being extraordinarily attractive.
lines.zh: : 好奇吧，我想。你「挑逗」得那么频繁，除了我格外有魅力之外，那些感情里总该有点值得记一笔的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t know how to break this to you, but that’s really all it takes sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道怎么跟你直说，但有时候真的就只需要这个。

lines.en: : But this is not one of those times as I know you well enough to know that you know me. So tell me — do you actually find me special? Or do you just say things like this for the fun of it?
lines.zh: : 但这次不是那种时候，因为我够了解你，也知道你够了解我。所以你告诉我——你是真觉得我特别？还是说这些话只是为了好玩？

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 说话啊？

lines.en: : Wakana, what’s going on? This is weird.
lines.zh: : Wakana，怎么了？这样很怪。

lines.en: : I’m trying to find the words. It’s just difficult. And I thought hearing you ramble about how great I am would give me the time needed to come up with an explanation.
lines.zh: : 我在找词。就是很难。我本以为听你絮叨我有多好，能给我腾出想出解释的时间。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes12
: Seems like that’s not in the cards either, though. And that my death-grip on life is loosening even quicker than Kafka’s battle with tuberculosis.
lines.zh: : 看来这也指望不上了。而且我死死攥着人生的那只手，松得比卡夫卡跟肺结核的搏斗还快。

lines.en: : Did...something happen with Osako?
lines.zh: : 是……Osako 那边出事了？

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes13
: Yes.
: Something happened.
lines.zh: : 出事了。

lines.en: : I asked her to marry me.
lines.zh: : 我向她求婚了。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes14
: You...did? But...then why are you-
lines.zh: : 你……求了？可……那你为什么还——

lines.en: : Because she turned me down, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为她拒绝了，显然是。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes15
: How? Why? Osako’s more in love with you than anyone has ever been in love with anyone in the history of the universe. I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 怎么会？为什么？Osako 爱你的程度，比宇宙历史上任何人对任何人的爱都深。我不明白。

lines.en: : I’m not sure how accurate that statement is given what I’ve heard about your childhood friend and her newfound interest in knife karate.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我听说的关于你那位青梅竹马和她新近迷上的刀法空手道，我不确定这句话有多准。

lines.en: : I’m just going to ignore whatever it is you heard about that from Osako and say that Niki is probably just insane and that she doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : 我就当没听见你从 Osako 那儿听来的那些，直接说 Niki 大概就是疯了，不算数。

lines.en: : I think we’re probably all a little insane at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 我想说到底，我们大概都有点疯。

lines.en: : So lost and confused that we can spend years of our lives right beside something or someone and just...completely overlook something so glaringly obvious.
lines.zh: : 迷茫到这种地步——我们能在某样东西或某个人身边耗上好几年，却……彻底漏掉一个明摆着的事实。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes16
: Perhaps it’s just an example of projection at play. Or believing in something because you want it to be true rather than ever actually thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 也许这不过是一场心理投射。或者是你因为希望它是真的才去相信它，而不是真的去想过它。

lines.en: : And I have so much to think about all of a sudden. So much that the writer part of me is frothing at the mouth from the potential fruits of all of this.
lines.zh: : 而我突然有那么多要想的。多到我身上那个作家的部分，光是想到这些可能结出的果实就垂涎得口吐白沫。

lines.en: : But the human part of me can’t help but be terrified of what branches may be snapped by plucking those fruits. I’m skeptical of their taste. Their texture. How it all feels.
lines.zh: : 可我身上属于人的那部分，却忍不住害怕摘那些果子会折断哪些树枝。我怀疑它们的味道。它们的口感。以及这一切摸上去是什么感觉。

lines.en: : What an odd place to find myself in. So distraught, yet oddly excited about all that’s left to see.
lines.zh: : 我竟落到这么一个奇怪的境地。心碎得不行，却又莫名其妙地期待还没看到的那些。

lines.en: : You guys...didn’t break up, did you? Because I know things haven’t been as perfect lately as they used to be, but-
lines.zh: : 你们……没分手吧？我知道最近是不如从前那么圆满，可——

lines.en: : I don’t want children, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我不想要孩子，Akira。

lines.en: : Well...that’s great news then. Because I don’t know if you know this about human reproduction, which I know you warned me not to talk to you about, but two women-
lines.zh: : 那……那是好消息啊。我不知道你知不知道人类繁殖的常识——我知道你警告过我别跟你提——但两个女人——

lines.en: : Osako does. Do you see what I’m saying?
lines.zh: : Osako 想要。你懂我意思了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes17
: She wants something I never even noticed. Something that, after all this time, shook me to my core and took my breath away not out of love or admiration, but shock.
lines.zh: : 她想要一样我从来没留意过的东西。一样在过了这么久之后，把我震到骨子里、让我喘不上气的东西——不是因为爱或欣赏，是因为震惊。

lines.en: : I just...didn’t know. And what does that say about me? One half should know its other. And I just...didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不知道。那说明我算什么？一半本该了解另一半。而我……就是不知道。

lines.en: : Well...maybe this is a new thing for her?
lines.zh: : 那……也许这对她来说是新冒出来的想法？

lines.en: : Maybe something or...someone made her realize that not everything is impossible even when it seems like it is.
lines.zh: : 也许是某件事、或者……某个人，让她意识到，就算看起来不可能的事，也并非全都做不到。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes18
: Ah.
: So it was you who planted the seed.
lines.zh: : 所以是你种下的这颗种子。

lines.en: : I obviously didn’t mean to. We were just talking about Ayane and then one thing led to another and-
lines.zh: : 我显然不是有意的。我们只是在聊 Ayane，然后一句接一句，就——

lines.en: : It’s fine. I don’t blame you.
lines.zh: : 没事。我不怪你。

lines.en: : If anything, I should be thankful this happened now instead of another decade down the line after wasting so much of her time on this god-forsaken planet.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我该庆幸这事发生在现在，而不是再拖十年、让她在这颗被上帝遗弃的星球上白耗掉更多时间。

lines.en: : Again, though — if this is a new thing, you shouldn’t beat yourself up about never realizing it. Things can still work out, can’t they? Maybe she...changes her mind?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来——如果这是新想法，你也不该为一直没察觉而自责。事情还有转圜的余地，不是吗？也许她……会改变主意？

lines.en: : Things like this don’t come out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 这种事不会凭空冒出来。

lines.en: : I could spend days or weeks or months convincing myself that this is some sort of spontaneous urge or phase, but I know in my heart that all I’d be doing in thinking that is deceiving myself.
lines.zh: : 我可以花上几天、几周、几个月说服自己这不过是一时的冲动或者阶段，可我心里清楚，这么想只是在骗自己。

lines.en: : I don’t want her to change her mind or settle for a life that’s less than perfect just to try and appease me. But again, I just...
lines.zh: : 我不想让她改变主意，也不想让她为了安抚我将就一段不够圆满的人生。可话说回来，我只是……

lines.en: : I don’t want children.
lines.zh: : 我不想要孩子。

lines.en: : It’s that simple...
lines.zh: : 就是这么简单……

lines.en: : To think a single disagreement after so much time and love could amount to so much is just...
lines.zh: : 想想看，在这么多时间和感情之后，一个分歧居然能酿成这么大的事，真是……

lines.en: : It’s hard for me to understand.
lines.zh: : 我很难理解。

lines.en: : So no, I’m not doing okay.
lines.zh: : 所以不，我一点都不好。

lines.en: : But, strangely enough, I don’t feel like crying.
lines.zh: : 但奇怪的是，我并不想哭。

lines.en: : How curious, this numbness is. How unwanted. How sudden.
lines.zh: : 这麻木多奇怪啊。多不受欢迎。多突然。

lines.en: : How there are both good and bad sides to it.
lines.zh: : 而且它竟有好的一面，也有坏的一面。

lines.en: : I think this is the end, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我想这就是结束了，Akira。

lines.en: : I think the dream is finally over.
lines.zh: : 我想这场梦终于做完了。

lines.en: : That said, we should probably start charging one another if we’re going to keep doing this. What with unadulterated happiness apparently not being in the cards and all.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，如果我们还要继续这样，大概该开始互相收费了。毕竟纯粹的快乐显然是不在我们的命里的。

lines.en: : You’ll find it one day, Wakana. There are very few people out there who deserve it more than you.
lines.zh: : 你总有一天会找到的，Wakana。这世上没几个人比你更配得上它。

lines.en: : I find it hard to believe that someone as selfish, obsessive, cynical, hostile, and overwhelmingly unpleasant as me could ever top the list of deserving anything worthwhile.
lines.zh: : 我很难相信，像我这样自私、偏执、愤世、充满敌意、又讨人厌到极点的人，能排在任何值得拥有之物的名单榜首。

lines.en: : As far as I’m concerned, all I’ve earned in all this time is exactly what I have given to others. Resentment. Exhaustion. Anguish.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，这么久以来我挣到的，跟我一直给别人的一模一样。怨恨。疲惫。痛苦。

lines.en: : All these things and more make up the Wakana Watabe you’ve been duped into befriending. And sooner or later, you’ll find that I’m nothing but a road to nowhere as well.
lines.zh: : 这些，还有更多，构成了你被骗着交上朋友的这个渡部 Wakana。早晚有一天你也会发现，我同样只是一条通向虚无的路。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes19
: Hey. There’s only enough room for one self-deprecating asshole in this friend group and that asshole is me.
lines.zh: : 嘿。这个朋友圈里只容得下一个自贬的混蛋，那个混蛋是我。

lines.en: : And yes, you might be selfish, obsessive, cynical, hostile, and overwhelmingly unpleasant — but you’re also creative, hot, artistic, hot, eccentric, and really fucking hot.
lines.zh: : 而且没错，你也许自私、偏执、愤世、充满敌意、又讨人厌——可你也有创意、很辣、有艺术感、很辣、古怪，而且他妈的真他妈辣。

lines.en: : That was basically just two adjectives. I actually feel even worse about myself now if that’s the best you can come up with.
lines.zh: : 那基本上只算两个形容词。如果这就是你能想出的最好听的，那我现在反而更瞧不上自己了。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes20
: I’m sure you do. But, on the bright side, this is probably the single lowest moment of your life so far. So you can take solace in knowing things can only go up from here.
lines.zh: : 我确定你会。不过往好处想，这大概是你这辈子到目前为止的最低点。所以你可以宽慰自己：往后再差也只能往上走了。

lines.en: : And that you’ll have an equally selfish, obsessive, cynical, hostile, and overwhelmingly unpleasant person beside you the whole way.
lines.zh: : 而且这一路上，都会有一个同样自私、偏执、愤世、充满敌意、又讨人厌的家伙陪在你旁边。

lines.en: : You don’t know that for sure. We haven’t seen what this will do to our group yet. For all we know, everything could fall apart and the two of us could wind up completely alone.
lines.zh: : 这你可说不准。我们还不知道这件事会把我们这群人搞成什么样。说不定一切都会散架，最后我们俩彻底孤家寡人。

lines.en: : Then let’s make a promise that you and I won’t ever fall out of touch even if that happens.
lines.zh: : 那就说好了——就算真到那一步，你我也绝不失去联系。

lines.en: : I don’t want to do that either, though. You’re even worse than me and I reserve the right to cut you off at any moment I find beneficial.
lines.zh: : 可我也不想说这种话。你比我更糟，而且我保留在任何我觉得划算的时刻跟你断交的权利。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Then I promise to not stop bothering you until that happens. You deserve at least one constant while everything else is changing. Okay?
lines.zh: : 行，好吧。那我保证，在那之前我会一直缠着你。别的一切都在变，你至少该有一个不变的东西。好吗？

lines.en: : Okay?
lines.zh: : 好吗？

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : You’re really impressive in a lot of really unpredictable ways sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你有时候真的挺了不起，而且是在很多完全想不到的地方。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes21
: Am I? How?
lines.zh: : 是吗？怎么说？

lines.en: : Just that you’ve done this multiple times before — lost someone who meant the world to you. And you’re still standing and telling me to go on while struggling to do the same yourself.
lines.zh: : 就是……你已经经历过好几次了——失去对你而言就是全世界的人。而你还站着，还劝我撑下去，尽管你自己要做到同样的事也费劲。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. That’s just one of the very few examples out there of hypocrisy being a net positive.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。这大概是世上少有的几个「虚伪最后变成好事」的例子之一。

lines.en: : It’s just a little admirable is all. I still think you’re a terrible, undesirable person who deserves all of the pain he routinely receives.
lines.zh: : 只是稍微有点让人佩服罢了。我依然觉得你是个糟糕透顶、没人要的家伙，活该承受他平时挨的那些痛。

lines.en: : And you are well within your right to think those things. But it changes nothing and I’m still here.
lines.zh: : 你完全有权利这么想。可这改变不了什么，我还在这儿。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes22
: You are...
lines.zh: : 你真是……

lines.en: : Aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我是。

lines.en: : But there’s one thing I should probably tell you before this goes any further.
lines.zh: : 不过在事情继续往下走之前，有件事我大概该告诉你。

lines.en: : Oh, joy. I’ve been waiting for the second shoe to drop for some time now. Walking around with one has been rather painful.
lines.zh: : 哦，真开心。我等另一只靴子落地已经等了好一阵了。只穿着一只走路挺疼的。

lines.en: : Wakana, if we’re going to keep being friends, I need you to know...
lines.zh: : Wakana，如果我们还要继续做朋友，我得让你知道……

lines.en: : That I also want kids.
lines.zh: : 我也想要孩子。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes23
: Please laugh. That was funny.
lines.zh: : 笑一下。那很好笑。

lines.en: : Hilarious.
lines.zh: : 太好笑了。

lines.en: : Too soon?
lines.zh: : 太早了？

lines.en: : Too soon.
lines.zh: : 太早了。

lines.en: : Got it. No more Osako jokes until I receive permission. See? I can be a good friend.
lines.zh: : 明白了。在拿到许可之前不再开 Osako 的玩笑。看吧？我也能当个好朋友。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes24
: You can, yes. When you actually want to be. I just wish that were more often.
lines.zh: : 你能，是的。在你真心想当的时候。我只希望那种时候能多一点。

lines.en: : Be careful what you wish for, Wakana. Saying things like that is only going to make me more annoying.
lines.zh: : 许愿要小心啊，Wakana。说这种话只会让我变得更烦人。

lines.en: : Can it wait a few minutes while I rest my head on your shoulder? Right on cue, my self-medication cocktail is making me tired again.
lines.zh: : 能不能等几分钟，让我先把头靠在你肩上？说曹操曹操到，我那杯自调药鸡尾酒又开始让我犯困了。

lines.en: : Sure, but...
lines.zh: : 当然，不过……

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, has that other side effect you mentioned kicked in yet?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇，你说的那个副作用来了没有？

lines.en: : What other side effect?
lines.zh: : 什么副作用？

lines.en: : You said the medication turns you on and then makes you tired.
lines.zh: : 你说那药会先把你搞兴奋，再让你犯困。

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes25
: I don’t remember saying that. You’re making things up.
lines.zh: : 我不记得说过这个。你在瞎编。

lines.en: : That...might be true. But I could have sworn-
lines.zh: : 那……可能是真的。可我发誓我——

lines.en: scene wakanabarclothes26
: No more words. Just let me rest and feel sorry for myself a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 别说话了。让我再靠一会儿，再为自己难过一会儿。

lines.en: : Fine. But I will not allow you to police anything that goes on in my head while that happens.
lines.zh: : 行。但我可不允许你在这期间管我脑子里想什么。

lines.en: : I’d say it’s probably best if we just stay out of each other’s heads entirely. I’m not sure you’re ready for what goes on inside of mine yet.
lines.zh: : 我看最好还是我们干脆都别进对方的脑袋。我不确定你已经准备好面对我里面那些东西。

lines.en: scene black
: What is that supposed to-
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思——

lines.en: : Goodnight, Arakawa. Wake me up in...ten minutes? Twenty maybe, if I look particularly peaceful.
lines.zh: : 晚安，荒川。……十分钟后叫我？要是我看起来格外安详，二十分钟也行。

lines.en: : Can I keep my arm around you at least?
lines.zh: : 至少让我还搂着你，行吗？

lines.en: : Just this once. But only because I don’t have the energy to fight back.
lines.zh: : 就这一次。只是因为我没力气反抗了。

lines.en: : I will do my best to...not keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我尽量……不去记着这句话。

lines.en: Wakana drifts off to sleep on my shoulder.
lines.zh: Wakana 靠在我肩上睡着了。

lines.en: I wake her up twenty minutes later.
lines.zh: 二十分钟后我叫醒了她。

lines.en: There is no more narration.
lines.zh: 没有旁白了。
